title: Chinena of Carthage
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 16:2: Rabbi Yaakov bar Acha, Chinena of Carthage, in the name of Rabbi Hoshayah. Hyman calls the Kartachaya reading in Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 1:6 an error.[^1]

notes.text: The digital Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 16:2 reads Chinena Kartigenaya, while Beitzah 1:6 reads Chinena Kartachaya in the parallel report. Hyman’s assessment of the latter as erroneous remains attributed.
